XYZ Corporation's financial health shows mixed signals. While revenue grew by 20% (from $500 million to $600 million), operating costs also increased significantly (from $300 million to $400 million), keeping the operating margin stable at approximately 33%. This indicates that cost management did not improve alongside top-line growth. More concerning is the rise in the debt-to-equity ratio from 0.5 to 0.8, signaling increased financial leverage and higher risk. The company is taking on more debt relative to equity, which could strain cash flows if interest rates rise or earnings decline.

The famous ship that sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg is the RMS Titanic.
